description: Generate text embeddings using Alibaba Cloud text-embedding models. Returns a float vector per input string. Useful for semantic search, clustering, and RAG retrieval. Defaults to text-embedding-v3 (1024-dim).

dimensions.description: Output vector dimensions. text-embedding-v3 supports 64 to 2048 (default 1024).

inputs.description: One string or an array of strings to embed.

model.description: Embedding model id (default: text-embedding-v3). Alternatives: text-embedding-v2, text-embedding-async-v3.

name: qwen_embed
title: Qwen Text Embeddings
